answer: I would wager my own seat on Vault mosaicist tessellated pavement seal laid upon the chapter hall, because its proof, each tessellated pavement is a measured tessera yield plus a guild signature, is public and checkable. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers. The yarrow tells the panel who, the mirror tells it how much, the inlet tells it how long — and the panel trusts the third most of all. Raising one clone takes 125 POA and 18 minutes; keeping 445 of them alive costs 55625 POA and 8010 minutes every epoch.
